# Anvik Labs

> Anvik Labs is a product design and engineering studio in India, helping startups and small businesses build clear interfaces, fast websites, and practical AI solutions.

- [Home](https://anviklabs.site/): Studio overview, services, team, and selected work.
- [Works](https://anviklabs.site/works): Case studies across product design, identity, editorial, and web development.
- [Product Design](https://anviklabs.site/services/product-design): UI/UX research, flows, Figma interfaces, and design systems.
- [Web Development](https://anviklabs.site/services/web-development): Fast, accessible React and TypeScript websites and apps.
- [AI Solutions](https://anviklabs.site/services/ai-solutions): LLM integrations, RAG search, and chatbot development.
- [Website Maintenance](https://anviklabs.site/services/website-maintenance): Ongoing updates, bug fixes, content changes, and hosting support.
- [Journal](https://anviklabs.site/journal): Notes on product design, web development, and building with AI.
- [Contact](https://anviklabs.site/contact): Start a project or ask a question.
